source_note: CI-only control checkout; exact C1 export checkout built separately. Exact test-only std patch embedded; no std push needed.

request.all_rows: exact request argv; ON/OFF differ only by -Z uninit-checks; object-bits=12; jobs=1

workflow.aggregate_cap_note: 12 serial 50-minute job timeouts form a proposed 10-hour workflow envelope; queue/setup overhead outside job timeouts is not measured or controlled here.
workflow.build: cargo build-dev -- --release from a separate exact C1 export checkout; overlay scripts/workflow are not built
workflow.kani_entrypoint: export/scripts/kani wrapper (execs target/kani/bin/kani-driver with argv0 kani)
workflow.artifact: per-root receipt.json, runtime-identities.json, export.json, stdout.log, stderr.log, job-status.json

receipt.parser: replay.py validates JSON parse/top-level type only; object envelopes remain UNVALIDATED_JSON_OBJECT
receipt.receipt_persistence: atomic execution snapshot is written before fallible enrichment; enrichment errors retain the snapshot and record stage/type/message
receipt.runner_exit: preserve positive child exit codes; return nonzero for malformed/missing exports, timeout, signals, runner errors, or incomplete postprocessing
preserves: stdout/stderr full files plus hashes and byte counts
receipt.negative_observation: REVIEW_REQUIRED; nonzero exit alone is never accepted as intended-read evidence
required_review: actual std worktree contains only the two pinned test-only patch paths
useful checks and Check body for each positive root
negative failure binds to intended live source[1] read
export identities and complete artifact coverage

workflow_manifest.synthetic_tests: test_replay.py covers success, failure, timeout, signal, partial, missing, null, wrong-type, wrong-source, and unbound/NOT_RUN handling; no Kani/compiler/build is invoked.
